evals.prompt: Refresh every official Waybar documentation reference in this project and make sure AGENTS.md links every fetched document.
evals.expected_output: The official repository and wiki documentation are fetched, indexed, and fully referenced in one generated AGENTS.md block.
assertions: The canonical man-page sources, official wiki, maintained examples, contributor docs, and protocol references are fetched from official Alexays/Waybar repositories.
AGENTS.md contains exactly one complete generated Waybar documentation block.
Every fetched documentation file is referenced in both references/INDEX.md and AGENTS.md.
Exact upstream commit identifiers are recorded.

evals.prompt: Update the Waybar docs index, but preserve the hand-written project instructions already in AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: The marked Waybar block is replaced idempotently while all text outside the block is unchanged.
assertions: Content before and after the generated markers is preserved.
Repeated synchronization does not duplicate the generated block.
The refreshed block references every fetched documentation file.

evals.prompt: Find the authoritative Waybar documentation I should use to change the network module tooltip and CSS states on this machine.
evals.expected_output: The response checks the installed Waybar version and points to the canonical network, styles, and states man sources, using wiki material only as a supplement.
assertions: The installed Waybar version is checked for version-sensitive behavior.
The canonical waybar-network, waybar-styles, and waybar-states man sources are selected.
The response distinguishes canonical man sources from supplemental wiki content.
